0022600156.text: The Golden State Warriors (3-3, on a three-game winning streak) host the LA Clippers (1-4, on a four-game losing streak) in the Warriors' seventh game of the 2026-27 season, with Golden State second in the Pacific and LA fourth. Golden State is missing Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery) and Stephen Curry (rest), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision, while LA is without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Max Strus (foot, plantar fasciitis). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Warriors lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 115-110 defeat in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
